simple.summary: חֲלִיפָה (chălîyphâh) means alternation First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 5 28.

definitions.full: H2487. chaliphah [ חֲלִיפָה ] noun feminine a change (from idea of replacing, changing, substituting , compare Arabic, Aramaic) — suffix חֲלִיפָתִי Job 14:14 ; plural absolute חֲלִיפוֺת Judg 14:19 3 t.; construct id. 14:13 ; 2Kin 5:5 ; חֲלִפוֺת Gen 45:22 2 t.; חֲלִפֹת 45:22 ; Judg 14:12 ; — 1 change of raiment ׳ח שׂמלת Gen 45:22 (twice in verse), elsewhere ׳ח בגדים Judg 14:12-13 , 2Kin 5:5 , 22 , 23 ; so without בגדים Judg 14:19 . 2 relays 1 Kings 5:28; compare ׳ח וצבא Job 10:17 (Di). 3 revival after death , under figure of relief from military service Job 14:14 . 4 changing, varying , of course of life לָ֑מוֺ חֲלִיפוֺת אֵין אֲשֶׁר Psa 55:20 of the wicked, with whom are no changings , i.e. they do evil incessantly, steadily (|| אלהים יָרְאוּ ולא ) so Kmp Hu De Sch and others; but the expression is peculiar and obscure; Calv vicissitudes ; Hengst discharges ; text perhaps corrupt.
